cc:Work.dc:description: The squares depict 2x2 pixel adjacency, not a metric planar 3D quadrilateral. Pij are 3D back-projected points. The same diagonal P10-P01 is used in both cases. Triangle acceptance is computed from all three vertex-depth edge differences. Left depths: 1.0,1.1,1.0,1.2. Right depths: 1.0,1.1,1.0,3.8. Threshold 0.4. First panel accepts both triangles; second retains T1 and rejects T2.
